distinguishing_features: Applies a high-gradient magnetic field directly to dissolved iron ions in rare-earth leachate.
Uses a magnetic matrix to retain the targeted species while the leachate flows through.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Reduce iron and thorium impurities in rare-earth leachate before further processing.
parsed.viable_reason: A magnetic gradient cannot practically capture dissolved ions at the stated scale, and Th(IV) is diamagnetic while many rare-earth ions are paramagnetic, so the mechanism neither reliably separates iron nor removes thorium.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The cited prior art provides no suggestion to use magnetic-gradient capture of dissolved ions, a step that is not a routine adaptation of its procedures.
